sandbox.title: Physics sandbox
sandbox.subtitle: Run isolated Newtonian experiments. Each preset resets to its own exact initial state.
sandbox.airburstFlag: The impact module heuristic flags possible airburst conditions.
sandbox.noAirburstFlag: The impact module heuristic does not flag airburst conditions.

validity.valid: Far-field range: Newtonian approximation marked valid by the model gauge.
validity.caution: Caution: Newtonian approximation is increasingly limited here.
validity.invalid: Outside the stated range of the Newtonian approximation.

notes.stable: JPL Solar System initial conditions, integrated with the app's fixed-step Newtonian engine.
notes.twoBody: Sun and Earth initial state from JPL; other bodies are omitted for this two-body experiment.
notes.impact: Earth and a 500 m radius, 3000 kg/m³ illustrative asteroid. Impact energy and the airburst flag use the impact module. The N-body engine does not resolve body contact, an atmospheric trajectory, or damage.
notes.starReplacement: Instantly replaces the Sun's gravitational parameter with half its initial value while preserving all positions and velocities. This is a controlled thought experiment, not stellar evolution.
notes.blackHole: A 1000 solar-mass non-rotating black hole and a test particle at 12 Schwarzschild radii. Newtonian particle motion is only an approximation; see the validity gauge.
notes.empty: An empty simulation clock with no bodies. Conservation diagnostics are undefined.

sandbox.starModelCard: Model Card · Instantaneous mass substitution. Other bodies keep their positions and velocities. No stellar evolution, mass loss, ejecta, or radiation is modelled.
sandbox.blackHoleModelCard: Model Card · Non-rotating Schwarzschild geometry for radius and gauge; test-particle trajectory remains Newtonian. No relativistic trajectory or light propagation.
sandbox.impactModelCard: Model Card · Spherical uniform-density impactor and Newtonian kinetic energy. Body contact is not resolved. Airburst output is a coarse heuristic, not a probability or damage forecast.
sandbox.newtonianModelCard: Model Card · Point-mass Newtonian gravity with a fixed-step velocity-Verlet integrator. Scene geometry is illustrative and not to scale.
